interaction.text: A little mailbox. Inside: a hand-written note that just says "you are doing fine."
The espresso machine hisses softly. Nobody is here to take your order, but the smell is lovely.
Today: green tea, burnt toast, one honest conversation. Pay what you can (nothing).
Spines worn soft. A paperback is bookmarked with a dried flower at the exact page you needed.
A candle someone left lit for whoever comes next.
A pot of chamomile, still warm. There is always one extra cup.
You look through the telescope. A smear of stars, a patient planet, and a plane carrying somebody home.
The fire pops. Nobody has to say anything.
Umbrellas left by people who stayed a little longer than planned.
Quiet corner. Be gentle. Say it with a small wave if you must.
